explanation: The AI response failed to identify most of the correct tropical cyclones meeting the criteria. It only included Hurricane Matthew (2016) from the ground truth list. It missed Hurricane Ian (2022), Hurricane Florence (2018), Hurricane Hermine (2016), Tropical Storm Beryl (2012), Hurricane Dennis (1981), and Hurricane Dora (1964). Furthermore, it hallucinated/incorrectly listed several storms not present in the correct set (Hurricane Floyd, Hurricane Dorian, Hurricane Irene, and Tropical Storm Jerry).
